## Experience Overview

My experience includes professional, internship, voluntary, and leadership roles across banking, finance, operations, retail, events, and community-focused organisations.

These experiences have helped me develop analytical thinking, communication, organisation, attention to detail, stakeholder awareness, and the ability to work responsibly in different professional environments.

## What This Experience Shows

Across these roles, I have developed a practical understanding of professional environments and strengthened my ability to work with people, information, and responsibilities in a structured way.

My experience demonstrates:

- Analytical thinking and evidence-based problem-solving
- Communication and stakeholder awareness
- Organisation, accuracy, and attention to detail
- Commercial and operational awareness
- Teamwork, responsibility, and adaptability
- Ability to learn across different professional environments
